metadata.notes: Runner registry — the actual wiring. Keys are `${algorithm}+${task}` composite IDs. Each entry carries the script path, hyperparameter defaults, CLI flag map, and HPO search space. If a (algorithm, task) pair is not in this file, that combo is not yet wired and the Train UI will show it as such. `legacyId` lets the orchestrator accept the pre-2026-05-09 modelType keys (xgb_classifier, etc.) and alias them to the composite key without breaking saved UI state.
